hero.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
hero.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: Iran war has cost on average $246 million per day in its first five months, CBO finds
latest.description: The Congressional Budget Office calculated the Defense Department's Iran war cost through Aug. 1 at $38.1 billion.

latest.title: Trump says Kennedy Center will stay closed without renovation unless his name is added back
latest.description: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.

latest.title: Senate cloture vote on Clarity Act fails, dealing regulatory blow to crypto industry
latest.description: The Senate on Tuesday voted to block the Clarity Act from advancing, dealing a blow to the crypto industry's push for a comprehensive market framework.

latest.title: Crypto Reacts: Bitcoin Slides as Clarity Act Fails to Clear Senate Vote
latest.description: The Senate fell short of the 60 votes needed to advance the crypto industry's marquee bill Tuesday. Bitcoin dropped as the no tally mounted, but the move stopped well short of panic.

latest.title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic discussing collaboration on AI safety issues
latest.description: Discussions have been ongoing since Google's Demis Hassabis released a proposal in July calling for a U.S.-led "Standards Body," the spokesperson said.

latest.title: Wells Fargo sees improvement in a key metric — plus, Lilly gets praise beyond GLP-1s
latest.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

latest.title: Crypto industry reacts after Clarity Act fails Senate vote
latest.description: One of the most crucial U.S. regulations for crypto markets couldn't secure enough support to clear the Senate's final 60-vote hurdle.

latest.title: AWS says it can't restore service to Bahrain, UAE facilities 6 months after Iran strikes
latest.description: In March, two Amazon data centers in the UAE were struck by drones, while a site was also damaged by a nearby drone hit.

latest.title: Clarity Act Stalls in Senate as Crypto Bill Fails to Clear Key Vote
latest.description: The crypto market structure bill failed to receive enough votes to advance in the Senate.

latest.title: Crypto Clarity Act flames out in failed U.S. Senate vote
latest.description: The years-long effort to set U.S. regulations for crypto markets couldn't muster enough support to make the leap over the Senate's final 60-vote hurdle.

latest.title: US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
latest.description: The failed procedural vote leaves the CLARITY Act facing an uncertain future after months of negotiations over crypto oversight and ethics provisions.

latest.title: AI skeptics from Bernie Sanders to Steve Bannon urge action, as Congress, Trump idle
latest.description: Lawmakers and AI regulation advocates met Tuesday in Washington at a Future of Life Institute event to urge regulatory action to rein in the expanding technology.

latest.title: Trump Account contributions have a Dec. 31 deadline — and employers can complicate the math
latest.description: Employers can offer Trump Account employee benefits via direct contributions or by allowing workers to make pre-tax contributions to a child's account.

latest.title: Ford increases V-8 engine availability, lowers performance prices for 2027 F-150 trucks
latest.description: Ford said the changes are meant to provide customers with more choice and help expand sales of key models, a strategy CEO Jim Farley has touted.

latest.title: Solana lender Kamino taps fintech veteran Michael Weisz as CEO for massive U.S. expansion
latest.description: Michael Weisz will lead Kamino from a new New York headquarters as the DeFi lender is expanding into tokenized assets.

latest.title: Stablecoin growth could boost dollar dominance, US Treasury demand: BoE official
latest.description: A Bank of England policy maker said digital dollars could expand access to the US currency while turning stablecoin issuers into bigger buyers of government debt.

latest.title: Robinhood Engineers Charged With Fraud Over Alleged Crypto Listing Trades
latest.description: Two employees allegedly earned more than $50,000 each by trading Hyperliquid perpetual futures before Robinhood announced new token listings.

latest.title: 'It's Now or Never' for Clarity Act, Says 'Bitcoin Senator' Lummis
latest.description: The Wyoming Republican says the final text hands Democrats more than 120 of their own demands, including sweeping new ethics rules, as the Senate holds a make-or-break cloture vote Tuesday afternoon.

latest.title: Trump’s opposition to AI rules undercuts industry's calls for a slowdown
latest.description: Anthropic and OpenAI have called for mandatory safety checks to be put in place as fears intensify that AI can soon be too powerful to control.
